picker.list: gh pr list --json number,title,author | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { "$($_.number)`t$($_.title) ($($_.author.login))" }
picker.header: Select pull request  [Enter to check it out]

picker.list: gh issue list --json number,title | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { "$($_.number)`t$($_.title)" }
picker.header: Select issue  [Enter to open it in the browser]
